normalized_actual.title: Install additional fuel filter
normalized_actual.steps: Place a suitable vessel underneath to collect the fuel. Replace left filter (1). Put lever (3) to position (b). Remove filter (1) using an oil filter wrench. Clean sealing face on filter head. Moisten sealing ring of new filter with fuel. Fit SOLAS shielding (→ Page 134). Install new filter and tighten by hand. Turn lever (3) to position (a). Replace right filter (2). Put lever (3) to position (c). Remove filter (2) using an oil filter wrench. Clean sealing face on filter head. Moisten sealing ring of new filter with fuel. Fit SOLAS shielding (→ Page 134). Install new filter and tighten by hand. Turn lever (3) to position (a). Vent additional fuel filter at screw (1). Remove vessel underneath for collecting the fuel.

normalized_actual.title: Change-over of fuel prefilter
normalized_actual.steps: Pull the changeover lever to switch the filter from operation to the desired position. Ensure the changeover lever is in the correct position as indicated by the tip facing the appropriate filter. Operate the engine at low load only to avoid danger zones and ensure safety. Wear suitable hearing protection due to high noise levels. Wear protective gloves, eye protectors/safety mask, and goggles or safety mask due to the risk of injury from fuel and pressurized media. Open the screw-coupling and tank slowly to prevent injury from escaping fluids and vapors. Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses to protect against burns and chemical hazards. Keep the engine room well ventilated to prevent fire and explosion risks. Avoid open flames, electrical sparks, and ignition sources to prevent fire and explosion. Do not smoke and avoid unprotected contact with hot surfaces. Allow the system to cool down to below 50 °C before beginning work to prevent damage to components. Wear suitable protective equipment/thermal gloves to prevent damage to components and severe material damage.

applicability_declarations.notes: REVIEWED (human decision, 2026-09) - approved as currently grounded, unchanged. This is the concrete motivating example for MaintenanceInterval = NOT_APPLICABLE. This is NOT a false negative and NOT automatically a true negative - it is excluded from FN/TN scoring entirely (see ExtractionApplicability's docstring). No other entity type is marked NOT_APPLICABLE for this document merely because it was not annotated - absence of a declaration means NOT_ASSESSED, never inferred. Human review explicitly declined to extend a similar NOT_APPLICABLE declaration to SparePart (see the fuel-filter window below): deferring detailed spare-part identification to an external Spare Parts Catalog is NOT equivalent to the SparePart entity concept being inapplicable to this document - SparePart remains unassessed/unrepresented instead.
